name: String Zero
source:
String Zero is an 18+ Furry Visual Novel set in another solar system, on another world. A Cyberpunk-themed epic, String Zero also includes fantasy and other science fiction themes and elements to give it a unique feel and spin.

The story follows Ravy, a young adult who struggles not only with a powerful ability to shape reality, but also a complicated relationship with his father, Aerran. Together along with their warrior-nun bodyguard Yuraeli, the three manage exile in the city-state of their home's enemy: a technologically-advanced corporatocracy, run entirely by the monolithic Company and its Chairman. Rather than the safety they hoped for, Ravy's family instead finds prejudice, corporate infighting, and dangerous truths, ultimately becoming embroiled in the hunt for ancient Jazz technologies that have both countries on the brink of war.

Join Ravy on a journey of self-discovery, navigating the dangers of both the city and his past while aligning himself with a curious crew of criminal 'runners,' each with their own particular agendas but one collective understanding:

The time of the Company is over.

[From [url=https://stringzerovn.itch.io/string-zero]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《零弦》是一部18岁以上的毛茸茸视觉小说，背景设定在另一个太阳系、另一个世界。作为一部赛博朋克主题史诗，《弦零》还包含奇幻和其他科幻主题和元素，赋予其独特的感觉和旋转。

故事讲述了拉维（Ravy），一个年轻的成年人，他不仅与塑造现实的强大能力作斗争，而且还与他的父亲艾兰（Aerran）之间的复杂关系作斗争。三人与他们的武士修女保镖尤拉埃利一起，在家乡的敌人的城邦中进行流亡：一个技术先进的企业集团，完全由庞大的公司及其董事长管理。拉维的家人并没有得到他们所希望的安全，反而发现了偏见、公司内斗和危险的真相，最终卷入了对古老爵士技术的追捕，这使两国都处于战争边缘。

与Ravy一起踏上自我发现之旅，探索这座城市和他过去的危险，同时与一群好奇的犯罪“跑步者”结盟，每个人都有自己的特定议程，但有一个集体理解：

公司的时代已经结束了。

[来自[url=https://stringzerovn.itch.io/string-zero]Itch.io[/url]]
